This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The Uploads section of the API reference lacks documentation about accepted amount formats. Adding a paragraph to specify that amounts accept a dot for decimals, commas for thousands, leading + or -, parentheses for negatives, and leading currency symbols €, $, £, or ¥ will clarify this for API users. This is purely a documentation change requiring no code modification or review.
